edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner from the untrusted msg.sender
onlyOwner modifier guards transferOwnership by comparing msg.sender to owner
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal the staged newOwner before transferring ownership
transfer debits the caller-controlled msg.sender balance
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller identity
transferFrom reduces the allowance of the caller msg.sender
approveAndCall sets allowance for msg.sender and passes msg.sender to the external callee
onlyOwner restricts transferAnyERC20Token to msg.sender == owner
newOwner staged by transferOwnership is consumed and cleared by acceptOwnership
owner is the only address allowed to trigger transferAnyERC20Token and is the transfer recipient
balances of msg.sender and to are read and written inside transfer
balances of from and to are read and written inside transferFrom
allowed mapping is written by approve
allowed[from][msg.sender] is decremented by transferFrom
allowed[msg.sender][spender] is written by approveAndCall
Constructor sets the fixed _totalSupply value
totalSupply reads _totalSupply
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner]
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender]
decimals feeds the exponent used to compute the initial _totalSupply
approveAndCall hands control to the attacker-supplied spender contract through receiveApproval after state changes
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call on an arbitrary token address supplied by the caller
SafeMath.add performs raw addition protected only by the require(c >= a) overflow guard
SafeMath.sub performs raw subtraction protected only by the require(b <= a) underflow guard
SafeMath.mul performs raw multiplication protected only by the division consistency guard
SafeMath.div performs raw division protected only by the require(b > 0) guard
transferOwnership stores the _newOwner parameter into the newOwner state variable
spender parameter is used as the allowance key in approve
spender parameter is the external contract address invoked by approveAndCall
tokens parameter is subtracted from the sender balance in transfer
tokens parameter is subtracted from both balances[from] and the allowance in transferFrom
to parameter receives the credited tokens in transfer
from parameter is the debited account in transferFrom
data parameter is forwarded into the receiveApproval callback
tokenAddress parameter determines the external contract called by transferAnyERC20Token
tokenOwner parameter indexes balances in balanceOf
parameter a is an operand of the checked addition in SafeMath.add
parameter b is an operand of the checked addition in SafeMath.add
local c holds the arithmetic result returned by SafeMath.add

normalization_plan.reason: The _newOwner parameter only exists to be written into newOwner by transferOwnership and can be folded into that function node
The spender parameter is purely an allowance key of approve/approveAndCall and can be folded into the approve function node
The tokens parameter is the amount moved by the transfer entry point and can be folded into the transfer function node
The to parameter is the credit target of transfer and can be folded into the transfer function node
The from parameter only exists as the debited account of transferFrom and can be folded into that function node
The data parameter is forwarded verbatim into the receiveApproval callback of approveAndCall and can be folded into that function node
The tokenAddress parameter selects the external contract of transferAnyERC20Token and can be folded into that function node
The tokenOwner parameter is only a lookup key for balanceOf/allowance and can be folded into the balanceOf function node
The a parameter is a transient operand of the SafeMath arithmetic helper and can be folded into the arithmetic operation node
The b parameter is a transient operand of the SafeMath arithmetic helper and can be folded into the arithmetic operation node
The local c variable is a transient arithmetic result holder and can be folded into the arithmetic operation node
